findings.description: get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) even when help is None, and the caller no longer substitutes an empty string. The docstring promises an empty description, but the code passes None through.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one documented Argument and one undocumented Argument, so format_options takes the branch that writes the section. Mechanism: the undocumented argument yields (metavar, None), and HelpFormatter.measure_table calls term_len on that None, which fails inside strip_ansi with a TypeError. Impact: --help crashes for any command that mixes documented and undocumented positional arguments, which is a common case.
